content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 ("Limitation of Liability") consists solely of a mutual consequential-damages waiver at p0027; a document-wide search for "exceed" and "aggregate" returns no monetary cap anywhere, and no cap is hidden in the warranty (Section 9) or indemnity (Sections 10-11) provisions. Both parties' direct liability is therefore unlimited, which fails even the fallback position (mutual cap of 12 months' fees). The carve-out architecture is directionally acceptable — indemnification and confidentiality breaches are already excluded from the damages waiver and are mutual — but without any cap the fallback's core material term is absent. Note also that Section 5 is a revenue-share under which Kubient pays Customer, so a cap keyed only to "fees paid by Customer" would be illusory; we therefore used amounts paid or payable between the parties plus the USD 1,000,000 floor from the preferred position, and expressly kept revenue-share amounts owed under Section 5 outside the cap.

proposal.summary: Add mutual monetary liability cap with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 7
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 waives consequential damages but contains no monetary cap, so both parties' direct liability is unlimited; we have added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' amounts paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, consistent with our standard position. Indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement remain outside the cap, and revenue-share amounts owed under Section 5 are not "damages" for cap purposes.

ops.text: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (i) THE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BETWEEN THE PARTIES UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (ii) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. AMOUNTS OWED BY EITHER PARTY UNDER SECTION 5 SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
